segments.title: the incompatible qualities

spans.tib: chu yin min gnyis po de
spans.eng: the quality of being water and the quality of not being water
if something exists and lacks one of these qualities, it must then possess the other

segments.note: PROVISIONAL machine alignment by Codex (GPT-6), independent reconciliation. The full chu yin min gnyis po de phrase owns the paired being-water/not-being-water qualities at d3: one Tibetan chu is shared by the opposed predicates, and gnyis po de identifies these two. No second Tibetan water is invented. mi 'thad par is the complete negative evaluation wrong at d3. The qualifier phan tshun spangs 'gal owns the closing mutual-exclusion definition at d3; its genitive gyi qualifies dngos 'gal, whose separate English exponent is directly incompatible. This allocation follows the local distinction between two mutually exclusive predicates and their explicit contradiction, and is supported by HGM11687 and HGM3657; the one directly incompatible occurrence is not claimed twice. The definition includes its existential restriction and implication unchanged. la sogs pa and gsum po are omitted: the three substances are recast as pus and blood versus either of the other two, so three must not own two. Remaining copular/consequence/final-reason framing is distributed and omitted, not nulled. Original wording and apostrophes are preserved; C05 has no appended C16 heading. No human approval or dictionary promotion is implied.
